versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1

- No changes detected in the code or documentation.
- No new features, fixes, or content updates in this release.

- Initial release of the "find-skills" skill for discovering and installing agent skills.
- Guides users on when and how to search for skills using the Skills CLI and skills.sh leaderboard.
- Provides quality-check steps before recommending skills, including install counts and source trustworthiness.
- Includes instructions and sample responses for recommending and installing skills.
- Offers advice for what to do if no relevant skill is found, including creating your own skill.
